purpose: Operational fit contract only. No fit, inference, or real data access was performed.

scope.candidate_features: Two-state Gamma-moment/OU filter features for the same HGB head.
scope.input: Read only origin.visible_records, each with explicit arrival_epoch already screened by the adapter, and origin.origin_stop_epoch. Require sample <= arrival <= query. Never infer arrival from arm names or access labels/targets/future rows.
scope.causality: Recompute the complete currently visible prefix in sample-time order, then propagate to the query. This is an O(n) causal reference implementation, not an O(1) online claim.
scope.late_first_measurement: Keep the first latent sample-time state internally while recording its actual arrival time. Require explicit arrival_epoch for every visible record and replay each measurement at sample time using its actual arrival time. Export is forbidden before the latest visible arrival.
scope.replay: 35 days limits each actual arrival_epoch - stop_epoch delayed-measurement replay interval only. It does not limit query minus latest sample or staleness. With no new measurement, propagate state and covariance through the full as-of gap. Full visible-prefix recomputation is O(n); overall runtime is separately controlled by GO.
scope.arrival_validation: Every record must include arrival_epoch; require finite stop_epoch <= arrival_epoch <= origin_stop_epoch. Reject any actual arrival-sample lag above 35 days. Do not guess arrival from arm.

initialization.q_reference: first sample among currently visible records

fit.budget: Six bounded CPU parameter-fit calls total: for each of candidate and scalar control, one full train-role fit plus two cell-fold training-only fits matching fixed seed-42 HGB OOF folds. Each branch has three calls, maxiter 200 each; any FIT_FAILED or IDENTIFIABILITY_STOP among its three stops that branch with no substitution.
fit.roles: Full fit uses train-role cells only. Each OOF-fold parameter fit uses only the complementary train-role cells; the held-out cells contribute neither health records to that parameter fit nor future labels. Equal cell weight, mean within-cell innovation loss. No event labels or target RUL.
fit.objective: Cell-balanced Gaussian innovation quasi-NLL: average over cells of each cell's mean 0.5*(log(2*pi*S)+e*e/S). Initialization measurement is not scored. This is a moment-Gaussian quasi-likelihood, not an exact Gamma likelihood.
fit.optimizer: Deterministic CPU L-BFGS-B, maxiter at most 200; no online updates.
fit.coordinates: Optimize theta=log(physical_parameter/reference). Candidate references and fixed starts: mu=0.25/365 Ah/day, v=1e-6 Ah^2/day, lambda=1/7 day^-1, Vz=1e-5 Ah^2, R=1e-6 Ah^2. Scalar references and starts: mu=0.25/365 Ah/day, process variance=1e-6 Ah^2/day, measurement variance=1e-6 Ah^2.
fit.hessian: Check parameter boundary proximity first in log coordinates; if any distance <=1e-6, return IDENTIFIABILITY_STOP without Hessian. Otherwise central-difference step per coordinate is min(1e-3, one quarter of the nearest log-bound distance), so all probes remain within bounds. Require finite positive-definite observed Hessian and condition number <=1e8.
fit.boundaries: Positive lower bounds exclude exact zero-process branches from these fits. Gamma conversion for positive mu and v: shape rate kappa=mu^2/v and scale theta=v/mu. OU diffusion sigma=sqrt(2*lambda*Vz). No relaxed bounds or retry.
fit.fail_closed: Nonconvergence, nonfinite loss/parameters, boundary proximity, non-positive Hessian, or condition number >1e8 returns FIT_FAILED or IDENTIFIABILITY_STOP; parameters are not usable.

scalar_control.model: One latent scalar cumulative loss x. Propagation x+=mu*dt; variance P+=v*dt. Measurement Q=q_ref-x+epsilon; ordinary Gaussian Kalman update with H=-1 and measurement variance R.
scalar_control.features: scalar loss, scalar variance, age, staleness from screened visible records only.

downstream: For each representation, use fold-specific parameters to construct held-out OOF features and full-train parameters for the final full-data HGB head. Same HGB head, objective, weighting and OOF/full budget for every representation. Development is evaluation only and does not tune parameters.
execution_gate: No optimizer call is authorized. Requires root exact-hash GO binding the six parameter-fit plus six HGB-fit (12 maximum CPU fits) budget, data/as-of approval, and fit receipt/hash guards. Implementation work is not an experiment.

validation.allowed: Static fold-role/interface inspection and mocked prediction-key comparison only; no optimizer or real data.
validation.forbidden: Real data, optimizer, fit, inference, development or locked reads.
validation.status: Pending root review. No optimizer call, real data access, or prediction was performed.
